topic: Binary Counting and the Towers of Hanoi: The Logic of Movement
target_audience: High school students or introductory computer science learners

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Language of Binary
lecture_lines: Each position represents a power of two.
Combine powers to form any number.
animations: Create a 3-bit binary display labeled #FFFFFF using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/computer.svg].
Show binary count mapping to decimal 0-7 using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/counter.svg].

sections.title: The Towers of Hanoi Challenge
lecture_lines: Three rods hold disks of varying sizes.
Move one disk at a time.
Never place larger on smaller disks.
animations: Display three [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/rod.svg] pegs with [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/disk.svg] disks stacked by size.
Show one [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/disk.svg] disk move from peg A to C.
Show recursive move: n-1 [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/disk.svg] disks move.

sections.title: Connecting Moves to Binary Counting
lecture_lines: Binary counting maps to disk moves.
Changing bits dictate which disk moves.
animations: Finalize alignment: binary states reflect [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/peg.svg] configurations.

sections.title: The Power of 2^n - 1
animations: Highlight formula result growing exponentially with disk [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/disk.svg] icons.
